basis: #73 Job Schema/match documentation and planner ruling https://github.com/Mingrui-Ai/ai-job-search-cn/pull/73#issuecomment-6514799668; mapping written before executing these frozen inputs on the PR.
policy: Keep frozen files unchanged. Separate implementation errors from contract differences. Only use base tech/ops profiles; frozen travel preferences have no schema representation in #73 and are not inferred from work-location choices.

contract_differences: Frozen interview travel refusals cannot be represented; the accepted contract emits a cost note instead of conflict.
Start-date unknown is a confirmation item, excluded from the overall verdict.
Mixed retains the required onsite round but not channel/order details.
Month precision is mapped to the latest date, not an exact start date; the lower edge of the month window is not stored.
Frozen interview travel refusals become a cost note, not conflict.
Phone/video alternatives are both online, not the online/onsite either mode.
Event-relative deadline is left null under the approved scope; it is not a missed supported absolute date.
Start-date unknown is excluded from the overall verdict.
Planner permits year inference, unlike the original frozen oracle: nearest to 2026-10-29 is 2027-01-10. Mark it as an inference in the check reason.
Interview unknown is excluded from the overall verdict.
